newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products propelled higher by futures rally.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products propelled higher by futures rally.

text.p: NWE oil products were propelled upward on Thursday by sharp gains on benchmark IPE gas oil and Brent futures.
Outright heating oil barges prices shot into the $230s a tonne range on the back of gains on the front-month January contract which was trading $7.75 up at $231.50 at 1100 GMT.
Premiums for first half January delivery were put at $1.50/$2.00 a tonne fob ARA.
But traders said that activity on the physical side was relatively muted as participants got back into the market after the Christmas/New Year holiday.

Traders also noted that while Arctic conditions across Europe bode well for futures contracts, they could be detrimental to premiums if transportation became difficult due to frozen waterways or blocked roads.
So far barge traffic on the Rhine has remained unaffected by the freezing weather, although ice was causing some problems on some tributaries and canals.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were stronger. Two parcels traded at 118 a tonne in early trade.
Eurograde gasoline barges were offered at $225, but no bids were heard as yet.
